strings.containers_not_installed_title: Docker or Podman is not installed
strings.containers_not_installed_text: Containers mode shows the containers, images, volumes and networks of a Docker or Podman engine on this computer. Install one of them, then check again.
strings.containers_docker_stopped_title: Docker is installed but not running
strings.containers_docker_stopped_text: The docker command is here, but nothing answers on its socket. Start the Docker service, then check again.
strings.containers_docker_stopped_hint: On macOS, open Docker Desktop instead.
strings.containers_podman_off_title: Podman is installed but its API service is off
strings.containers_podman_off_text: OTTY talks to Podman through its API socket, which is off by default. Turn it on for your user, then check again.
strings.containers_podman_off_hint: On macOS, run podman machine start instead.
strings.containers_both_off_title: Docker and Podman are installed, but neither is answering
strings.containers_both_off_text: The docker and podman commands are here, but nothing answers on their sockets. Start the one you use, then check again.
strings.containers_both_off_docker_label: To start Docker, run this in a terminal
strings.containers_both_off_podman_label: To turn on the Podman API service, run this in a terminal
strings.containers_docker_no_access_title: OTTY has no access to the Docker socket
strings.tpl_containers_docker_no_access_text: {socket} belongs to the docker group, and your user is not in it.
strings.containers_docker_no_access_label: Add your user to the docker group
strings.containers_docker_no_access_hint: Log out and back in afterwards. Members of the docker group have root-level access to this computer.
strings.containers_podman_no_access_title: OTTY has no access to the Podman socket
strings.tpl_containers_podman_no_access_text: Your user may not connect to {socket}. Turn on your own Podman socket, which needs no extra rights, then check again.
strings.containers_podman_no_access_label: Turn on your own Podman socket
strings.containers_podman_no_access_hint: It shows your own containers, not root's. On macOS, run podman machine start instead.
strings.containers_docker_no_access_podman_off_t: OTTY has no access to Docker, and Podman is off
strings.tpl_containers_docker_no_access_podman_o: {socket} belongs to the docker group, and your user is not in it. Podman is installed, but its API service is off.
strings.containers_podman_no_access_docker_off_t: OTTY has no access to Podman, and Docker is not running
strings.tpl_containers_podman_no_access_docker_o: Your user may not connect to the Podman socket {socket}. Docker is installed, but it is not running.
strings.containers_panel_not_installed: No engine found on this computer.
strings.containers_panel_podman_off: The Podman API service is off.
strings.containers_panel_both_off: Docker and Podman are not answering.
strings.containers_panel_docker_no_access: No access to the Docker socket.
strings.containers_panel_podman_no_access: No access to the Podman socket.
strings.containers_panel_docker_no_access_podman: No access to Docker, and Podman is off.
strings.containers_panel_podman_no_access_docker: No access to Podman, and Docker is not running.
strings.tpl_containers_looked_for: OTTY looked for {places}, and for docker and podman on PATH and in the usual install folders.

strings.containers_image_dangling: Dangling: no tag and no container uses it
strings.containers_status_both_off: docker and podman are not answering
strings.tpl_containers_status_docker_no_access_p: permission denied on {socket}, podman socket is off
strings.tpl_containers_status_podman_no_access_d: permission denied on {socket}, docker is not running
strings.containers_shell_needs_docker: Shell needs the docker command. Install Docker, then check again.
strings.containers_shell_needs_podman: Shell needs the podman command. Install Podman, then check again.
strings.containers_remove_container_text: The container and the changes made inside it are deleted. Named volumes stay.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_containers_text: Stopped containers to delete: {count}. The changes made inside them are lost; named volumes stay.
strings.containers_remove_image_text: The image is deleted from this computer. You can pull it again later.
strings.containers_force_remove_image: Force: a container still uses it
strings.containers_remove_tag_text: Only this tag goes. The image stays, with its other tags.
strings.containers_force_untags_image_text: Only this tag goes. A container still uses the image, so the image stays, without a tag.
strings.containers_force_deletes_image_text: The image is deleted. The stopped containers that use it stay.
strings.containers_force_deletes_containers_text: The image is deleted, and so are the stopped containers that use it.
strings.containers_remove_image_needs_force_text: A container still uses this image, so the engine refuses unless Force is on.
strings.containers_remove_image_refused_text: A running container uses this image, so the engine refuses. Stop it first.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_images_text: Dangling images to delete: {count}. They have no tag and no container uses them.
strings.containers_remove_volume_text: The volume and all data in it are deleted. This cannot be undone.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_volumes_text: Volumes no container uses: {count}. They and all data in them are deleted, named ones too. This cannot be undone.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_anonymous_volumes_t: Anonymous volumes no container uses: {count}. They and all data in them are deleted. Named volumes stay. This cannot be undone.
strings.containers_remove_network_text: Containers can no longer join it.
strings.tpl_containers_prune_networks_text: Networks no container uses: {count}. Built-in networks stay.
strings.tpl_containers_volume_in_use_hint: Remove the container {names} first; the engine keeps volumes that are in use.
strings.containers_built_in_network_hint: The engine creates this network itself; it cannot be removed.
strings.containers_network_in_use_hint: Stop or remove the connected containers first.
strings.containers_logs_hint: Last 500 lines, new lines appear as they come.
strings.containers_run_subtitle: Starts a new container in the background. If it needs a terminal, open it with Shell afterwards.
strings.containers_run_pull_missing: Pull the image if it is missing
strings.containers_run_command_hint: Leave empty to run the image's own command.
strings.tpl_containers_run_command_hint: Leave empty to run the image's own command: {command}
strings.containers_run_volume_source: Volume or folder on this computer
strings.containers_run_relabel: Let the container read this folder (:z)
strings.containers_run_relabel_hint: Changes the SELinux labels of the folder's files.
strings.containers_restart_hint_on_failure: Starts again when it exits with an error.
strings.containers_restart_hint_unless_stopped: Comes back after a crash or a reboot, until you stop it.
strings.containers_restart_hint_always: Comes back after a crash or a reboot, even after you stopped it.
strings.containers_restart_hint_auto_remove: A container that is removed when it stops cannot restart.
strings.containers_run_auto_remove: Remove the container when it stops
strings.containers_run_err_image: Type an image, for example nginx:1.27.
strings.containers_run_err_port: A port is a number from 1 to 65535.
strings.containers_run_err_container_path: The path in the container must start with /, for example /cache.
strings.containers_run_err_source_required: Type a volume name or a folder on this computer.
strings.containers_run_err_source_missing: This folder is not on this computer.
strings.containers_run_err_source_not_answering: This folder is not answering. A network drive may be unavailable.
strings.containers_run_err_source_home_unknown: Your home folder is not known, so ~ cannot be used. Type the full path.
strings.containers_run_fix_fields: Fix the marked fields to run.
strings.containers_run_panel_hint: What the image sets on its own. The form overrides it.
strings.containers_run_image_pulled_first: Not on this computer yet; it is pulled first.
strings.containers_run_image_not_pulled: Not on this computer yet. Turn on the pull switch, or the run fails.
strings.containers_run_no_image: Type an image to see what it sets on its own.

strings.agents_no_agent_text: Agents mode shows the projects and sessions of Claude Code and Codex. OTTY looks for their programs and config folders. Install one of them, then refresh.
strings.agents_start_text: Pick a project on the left to see its sessions. Continue one or start a new one: it opens in a terminal tab in the project folder.
strings.agents_open_folder_terminal: Open the folder in a terminal tab
strings.agents_sessions_hint: Double-click a session or press Enter to continue it in a new terminal tab.
strings.agents_folder_missing: This folder no longer exists, so its sessions can not be opened.
strings.tpl_agents_profiles_read_failed: Could not read the agent profiles: {error}
strings.tpl_agents_folder_unreadable: Could not read the folders of {name}: {error}
strings.tpl_agents_limits_changed: Could not read the usage of {name}: the agent answered in a way OTTY does not know, it may have changed. {error}
strings.tpl_agents_program_stopped: A program stopped unexpectedly while reading the usage of {name}: {error}
strings.agents_not_logged_in_hint: Nobody is logged in with this config folder. Log in opens a terminal tab where the agent logs in; refresh once it is done.
strings.agents_program_not_found_hint: The agent's program was not found. Install it, or set the path of the program with Edit.
strings.agents_config_dir_not_found_hint: The config folder was not found. Choose another folder with Edit.
strings.agents_create_folder_hint: OTTY creates this folder. Log in from the profile afterwards.
strings.agents_error_name_taken: Another profile already has this name
strings.agents_error_folder_empty: Type the path of the folder
strings.agents_error_folder_not_full: Type a full path, such as ~/.claude-work
strings.agents_error_folder_taken: Another profile of this agent already uses this folder
strings.agents_saved_file_unread: agents.json could not be read, so OTTY does not change it. Fix or remove the file, then refresh.
strings.tpl_agents_remove_text: OTTY forgets this profile. The folder {path} and its sessions stay on disk.
strings.agents_credits_no_balance: This plan does not report a balance.
strings.tpl_agents_limits_read_failed: Could not read the limits again: {error}
strings.agents_limits_log_in_again: Open the agent to log in again, then refresh.
strings.agents_search_hint: Type a name or a part of the folder
strings.agents_filter_recent: Projects used in the last 30 days
strings.tpl_agents_money_estimate: Tokens from the session files at the LiteLLM prices updated {time}, an estimate
strings.tpl_agents_money_unpriced: {count} requests this month have no price, so their money is not counted
strings.agents_typed_folder_hint: A folder that already holds the agent's files, such as a second account.
strings.agents_money_from_bill: From the bill, for the whole organization
strings.agents_admin_key_hint: Reads the real bill of the whole organization. OTTY saves only this path or name, never the key.
strings.agents_error_key_path_not_full: Type a full path, such as ~/.config/anthropic-admin-key
strings.agents_error_variable_name: Use letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit
strings.agents_source_tip_anthropic_usage_api: Asks anthropic.com directly for the limits of the account, with the login Claude Code keeps in the profile folder
strings.agents_source_tip_claude_usage_command: Runs claude in a hidden terminal and reads its /usage screen; used when the direct request gives no answer
strings.agents_source_tip_chatgpt_usage_api: Asks chatgpt.com directly for the limits of the account, with the login Codex keeps in the profile folder
strings.agents_source_tip_codex_app_server: Asks the codex program for the limits
strings.agents_source_tip_latest_codex_session: The latest limits Codex wrote in its session files
strings.agents_source_tip_session_files: The agent's session files on this computer
strings.agents_source_tip_agent_database: The agent's own database on this computer, opened read-only
strings.agents_source_tip_anthropic_cost_report: The cost report of the organization, read with the admin key
strings.agents_source_tip_session_files_at_list_: The tokens of the session files at the LiteLLM prices; an estimate
strings.agents_source_tip_cost_written_by_agent: What the agent itself wrote each answer cost, in its database: exact, not an estimate

strings.agents_source_tip_kept_prices: The copy of the LiteLLM prices saved on this computer at the last good read
strings.agents_source_tip_plugin: Read by a part of a plugin, which runs in a closed box with only the permissions it declares
strings.agents_no_prices: Could not get the prices. Press Refresh to try again.
strings.tpl_agents_prices_unreadable: Could not read the LiteLLM prices: {error}
strings.tpl_agents_found_intro: Profiles found: {profiles}. Accounts found: {accounts}. OTTY only read the agents' files; nothing was changed and nothing had to be typed.
strings.agents_need_admin_key_title: The real bill needs an admin key
strings.agents_need_admin_key_text: OTTY shows an estimate from the tokens. The bill of the whole organization needs an admin key, and no agent keeps one.
strings.tpl_agents_need_no_provider_text: Key for {host} found in {agent}: no provider plugin. OTTY shows its tokens and an estimate of the money, but not what is left.
strings.tpl_agents_need_login_expired_text: OTTY never renews a login it found in an agent. Open {agent}: it renews the login or asks you to log in again, and OTTY picks the new login up by itself.
strings.tpl_agents_failure_format_changed: the format of the session files changed: {understood} of {seen} records understood
strings.agents_plugin_failure_stopped: the plugin stopped with an error
strings.agents_plugin_failure_too_slow: the plugin did not finish in time
strings.agents_plugin_failure_paused: paused after three failures in a row
strings.agents_plugin_failure_could_not_read: the plugin could not read what it needs
strings.tpl_agents_need_format_changed_text: This OTTY reads them up to {agent} {tested}. Tokens since {time} are missing; OTTY shows the last good numbers, greyed. Limits, other profiles and accounts work as usual. Update OTTY when a new version is out.
strings.tpl_agents_need_format_changed_no_number: This OTTY reads them up to {agent} {tested}, so it shows no tokens of this profile yet. Limits, other profiles and accounts work as usual. Update OTTY when a new version is out.
strings.tpl_agents_need_format_changed_plugin_te: The {plugin} plugin {version} reads them up to {agent} {tested}. Tokens since {time} are missing; OTTY shows the last good numbers, greyed. Limits, other profiles and accounts work as usual. Update the plugin when a new version is out.
strings.tpl_agents_need_format_changed_plugin_no: The {plugin} plugin {version} reads them up to {agent} {tested}, so OTTY shows no tokens of this profile yet. Limits, other profiles and accounts work as usual. Update the plugin when a new version is out.
strings.agents_usage_money_note: An estimate: the tokens at the list prices.
strings.agents_money_subscription: Paid by a subscription: there is no price per request
strings.agents_money_no_prices: The list prices are not read yet
strings.tpl_agents_accounts_not_told: {agent} does not write which of its {count} {provider} accounts served a message
strings.tpl_agents_no_sessions_yet: {agent} has no sessions yet. OTTY counts them as soon as there are some.
strings.tpl_agents_installed_not_used: {agent} is installed, but has no sessions and no logins yet. OTTY picks them up as soon as you use it.
strings.tpl_agents_left_out_of_money: Left out of the money, paid by a subscription: {names}
strings.palette_new_agent_session_here: New agent session in this folder
strings.agents_error_folder_not_full_path: Type a full path, such as ~/projects/app
strings.agents_no_profile_to_start: No profile can start a session: its program was not found
strings.tpl_agents_failure_program_stopped: stopped unexpectedly: {program} ended before it answered
strings.agents_admin_key_variable_not_valid: the name of the key variable is not valid
strings.tpl_agents_no_limits_in_session_files: no limits in the {count} newest session files
strings.agents_login_may_not_read_usage: the login token may not read the usage
strings.agents_api_key_login: a login with an API key has no usage limits
strings.agents_claude_asks_api_key: claude asks whether to use an API key
strings.agents_claude_asks_look: claude asks to choose its look
strings.tpl_agents_claude_asks_trust: claude asks whether to trust another folder: {path}
strings.agents_claude_asks_trust_again: claude asks again whether to trust its folder
strings.agents_claude_rate_limited: claude says the usage was asked too often
strings.agents_answer_not_json_object: the answer is not a JSON object
strings.agents_not_cost_report: the answer is not a cost report
strings.agents_too_many_pages: the cost report has too many pages
strings.agents_price_file_no_prices: the price file has no prices
strings.agents_usage_panel_unreadable: the usage panel shows no percent used or left
strings.agents_program_not_now: OTTY starts it only while Agents mode is on screen
strings.tpl_agents_folder_has_files: the folder {path} already has files in it
strings.agents_hidden_terminal_needs_unix: a hidden terminal needs a Unix system
strings.agents_add_account_text: For a key no agent uses, or the admin key of an organization's bill. OTTY saves only the path of the file or the name of the variable, never the key.
strings.agents_source_tip_openai_costs: The costs of the whole OpenAI organization, read with its admin key
strings.agents_source_tip_deepseek_balance: The money left on the DeepSeek account, asked of DeepSeek with its key
strings.agents_source_tip_openrouter_key: The limit of the OpenRouter key and what it used, asked of OpenRouter with the key
strings.agents_source_tip_moonshot_balance: The money left on the Moonshot account, asked of Moonshot with its key
strings.agents_source_tip_kilo_balance: The money left on the Kilo account, asked of Kilo with its login
strings.agents_no_account_source: OTTY reads nothing of this account by itself
strings.agents_key_gone: the key is no longer where OTTY found it
strings.agents_keyring_not_read: the system keyring could not be read
strings.agents_answer_not_balance: the answer is not a balance
strings.agents_key_not_saved: A key can not be renamed or hidden yet: OTTY keeps nothing taken from a key.
strings.agents_hidden_account_note: Hidden: OTTY does not read this account. ⋯ → Show again brings it back.
strings.agents_hidden_profile_note: Hidden: OTTY does not read this profile. ⋯ → Show again brings it back.
strings.agents_rename_account_text: A name of your own, to tell accounts apart. OTTY keeps it; the provider does not see it. Leave it empty to show the provider and the login.
strings.agents_rename_profile_text: A name of your own, to tell profiles apart. OTTY keeps it; the agent does not see it.
strings.tpl_agents_need_keyring_text: {agents} keeps keys there, and their accounts can not be shown until OTTY may read them. OTTY only reads the entries of your agents and never changes them.
strings.agents_keyring_not_available: No system keyring answered: OTTY found no Secret Service or Keychain to read.
strings.agents_keyring_not_allowed: The keyring stayed locked, or the read was refused. Try again and unlock it when your system asks.
strings.agents_keyring_unreadable: A keyring entry of your agents is not in a shape OTTY knows.
strings.tpl_agents_keyring_dialog_text: {agents} keeps its keys in the system keyring. OTTY reads the entries of {agents} only, to show the accounts of those keys. It never changes or copies them. Your system may ask you to unlock the keyring once.
strings.desc_plugins: Add, update and turn off the plugins that teach OTTY to read agents and providers.
strings.plugins_empty_hint: A plugin teaches OTTY to read an agent or a provider. Paste the link of its GitHub repository.
strings.plugins_folder_label: Folder with otty-plugin.toml, the built .wasm and the icons
strings.plugins_official_note: Official plugin: reviewed by the OTTY team
strings.plugins_community_note: Community plugin: reviewed by its author only
strings.plugins_local_note: Local plugin: installed from a folder on this computer and never updated on its own
strings.plugins_update_asks: The new version asks for more. The installed version keeps running until you agree.
strings.plugins_log_empty: The plugin wrote nothing to its log yet.
strings.plugins_remove_text: Its files are deleted. The names and hidden items of Agents mode stay.

strings.tpl_plugins_perm_reads_key_in_variable: Reads your key in the variable `{name}` (OTTY gives it only as a handle)
strings.tpl_plugins_perm_gets_provider_keys: Gets the logins and keys of {provider} accounts found in your agents, as handles
strings.tpl_plugins_error_bad_url: `{url}` is not a GitHub repository link such as https://github.com/owner/repository
strings.plugins_error_rate_limited: GitHub refuses more requests from this computer for now. Try again in an hour.
strings.tpl_plugins_error_not_found: The repository {url} is private or does not exist
strings.plugins_error_no_release: This repository has no release OTTY can install
strings.tpl_plugins_error_manifest: The manifest of the plugin is refused: {error}
strings.tpl_plugins_error_version_is_not_tag: The release {tag} holds the plugin version {version}; they must be the same
strings.tpl_plugins_error_download: The file `{name}` could not be downloaded: {error}
strings.tpl_plugins_error_too_large: The file `{name}` is larger than {limit} bytes
strings.tpl_plugins_error_id_taken: A plugin `{id}` is already installed from {origin}
strings.tpl_plugins_error_release_changed: The release {tag} of {name} changed after it was installed. OTTY keeps the installed copy.
strings.tpl_plugins_error_other_plugin: The new copy is the plugin `{found}`, not `{expected}`
strings.tpl_plugins_error_damaged_built_in: The built-in copy of `{id}` is damaged

strings.tpl_plugins_error_not_local: The plugin `{id}` was not installed from a folder
strings.tpl_agents_need_part_off_text: {part} of the {plugin} plugin is off. OTTY reads none of this account's numbers until it is on.
strings.tpl_agents_need_plugin_update_text: {plugin} {from} → {to} asks for new permissions. The installed version keeps running until you agree.
strings.tpl_agents_need_plugin_failed_text: {reason}. The last good numbers stay. Copy the report for the plugin's author.
